buri.name: 부리
buri.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE animal character sprite sheet, exactly THREE full body poses horizontal on actual transparent RGBA background, generous separate margins. Reference 1 APPROVED Daram is authoritative STYLE: same head/body proportion (head roughly third), chunky square pixels, navy stepped outline, simple dark pupil and single white highlight, broad 3-4 shade clusters, bright readable midtones. Reference 2 environment palette only, no background. Clothes on bipedal animal, slight three quarter right. Same height and EXACT SAME feet baseline for all 3 poses. No text, labels, floor shadow, glossy surfaces, blur, realistic fur, tiny folds, anime eyes, baby giant head, human face/hair/nose/hands. Fully visible ears/tails/props/feet. Left BASIC / middle THINK wing-tip or furry paw under chin / right restrained EMOTION. Keep expressions readable at 96px portrait and full body 90px.
Buri, young brown OWL bookworm. Full owl head with rounded facial discs, round open eyes yet Daram-style dark simple pupils, small owl beak, few feather tufts, compact wings ending in FEATHER TIPS as hands, owl talons. Burgundy/plum vest over plain cream shirt, dark brown modest trousers. Hold a single closed plain book, no writing. Basic earnest quiet bookworm. Thinking wing tip beneath beak, book tucked by side. Emotion hurt and wistful, brows lifted toward center, gaze slightly down, closed beak: grandfather trusted someone else and Buri is ashamed of concealing it. No tears streaming or slapstick. Simple feather surfaces, similar overall body length to Daram, not a fat spherical mascot.
